notes: This portable C++ TCK slice creates directed publications for an adapter-supplied 2025 FDD inheritance fixture, verifies the populated and partially unpublished MIM states, then calls the class-scoped unpublish overload for every object class and queries the resulting state through standard HLArequestPublications. It checks the 2025 MIM NULL response parameter shape while ordinary object-attribute and interaction publications remain. Provider package, FOM modules, endpoint, callback configuration, class names, and logical-time implementation are adapter inputs. Portable source uses only official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ APIs and the C++ standard library.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void unpublishObjectClassDirectedInteractions( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass) = 0
